query:
UPDATE reco_settings SET tracks_per_day = COALESCE($1, tracks_per_day),
                max_index = COALESCE($2, max_index), max_hops = COALESCE($3, max_hops),
                hop_decay = COALESCE($4, hop_decay), utc_offset_min = COALESCE($5, utc_offset_min),
                updated_at = now()
         WHERE id
